name: 53190 · Whitewater, WI
findings: ZIP 53190 (Whitewater) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53190 (Whitewater) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53190 (Whitewater) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
